content: {"doneWhen":{"path":"farm.parsnips_planted_and_watered","op":">=","value":6},"modes":[{"id":"mode","priority":10,"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"field-work"}}],"skills":[{"name":"field-work","skill":"async (b) => { const tiles = []; for (let y = 3; y <= 5; y++) { for (let x = 7; x <= 9; x++) { tiles.push([x, y]); } } for (const [x, y] of tiles) { b.log('Working tile ' + x + ',' + y); let r = await b.workTile(x, y, 0, 'ControllerX'); b.log('till: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 2, 'ControllerA'); b.log('plant: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 1, 'ControllerX'); b.log('water: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); } }","check":"async (b) => { const obs = await b.observe(); const m = obs.match(/(\\d+)\\s*parsnip/i); const n = m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0; return { ok: n >= 6, detail: 'parsnips planted+watered: ' + n }; }"}]}
